final_destination_route.instructions: What hiring pipeline decision should be made based on the weighted composite profile?

criteria.hire_immediate: Fast-Track Offer / Executive Debrief - Exceptional composite fit (score >= 0.80).
criteria.onsite_loop: Full Technical Onsite Interview Loop - Strong candidate meeting role bar (score 0.65 - 0.79).
criteria.team_pipeline_review: Team Pipeline Review - Borderline candidate requiring hiring manager review (score 0.50 - 0.64).
criteria.archive_future: Archive for Future Opportunities - Does not meet senior requirements at this time (score < 0.50).
